Reverse-polarity protection: Anderson SB50 pair + 10 A charge fuse (G4) + Pololu 5388 20 A ideal diode on the unswitched control bus + 1N5408 in the KM coil feed (KM cannot close on a reversed pack) + SMDJ33A TVS on the drive bus
lines_donor.why: A 60-80 A ideal diode in the motor path (IDLD-100-TWOG, 80 A, EUR 9.53 ex VAT, hestore.eu) would block MDDS30 regenerative current and pump the bus above 35 V. The 100 A contactor already in series becomes the RPP element: zero extra heat in the motor path; Pololu 5388 (<3 mOhm, 20 A) dissipates ~0.1 W at 6 A.
